messages.author: amelia.marsh.102296@lakemail.example
messages.text: Glad ICF set up this regional group for us. Linda and I are looking forward to comparing notes with everyone across the ditch and down in Bega.

messages.author: ruth.holloway.101191@ostergaardfarmstead.example
messages.text: We are adjusting our make schedule this month to test a new washed rind. Xia has been leading the trials in the vat room.

messages.author: brian.ashcroft.100921@homestead.example
messages.text: Good to catch up on the monthly video call today. Hannah raised some very fair points about moisture loss during transport to the North Island.

messages.author: josie.beckett.100197@bluebarn.example
messages.text: Demand is staying very high for the six-month cheddars, but staffing our counter has been a real challenge lately.

messages.author: amelia.marsh.102296@lakemail.example
messages.text: Thanks to everyone who joined the call yesterday. Let us keep sharing notes on milk protein variations as the spring flush finishes up.

messages.author: tessa.pemberton.100412@lambswickdairy.example
messages.text: We are looking closely at our packaging line costs this quarter given the supplier price increases. Uche has been running some waste reduction audits.

messages.author: ruth.holloway.101191@ostergaardfarmstead.example
messages.text: ICF staff sent through the hardship dues details for anyone needing assistance this season. Please reach out privately if you need to talk through options.

messages.author: brian.ashcroft.100921@homestead.example
messages.text: The discussion around raw-milk aging rules on the last call was timely. We are trying to align our record-keeping with the new traceability standards.

messages.author: amelia.marsh.102296@lakemail.example
messages.text: Minh has done great work on herd records this winter, which makes our compliance paperwork much simpler now.

messages.author: josie.beckett.100197@bluebarn.example
messages.text: It feels like costs are finally steadying out as we head toward summer. See everyone on the next video check-in.
